reason: Share provider packet/referral tracking; retain referral receipt/acceptance and authorization outcome as distinct observations.
Share the case owner, but make identity matching explicit before attaching evidence.
Share benefits lookup and packet preparation; never equate verified benefits with authorization or payment.
Share administrative tracking and scheduling where permitted; booked, cleared and performed remain distinct.
Share evidence retrieval/consistency review, but use the actual release purpose and clarification/authorship process.
Common documentation support is plausible; code selection and clinical fact clarification remain different work.
Share payer intake/benefit state; apply only explicitly delegated limited nonclinical decisions.
The payer owner may invoke notice preparation/delivery, but the notice must derive from the authorized decision and cannot create it.
Share criteria/evidence infrastructure; retain the actual initial-review stage, expertise, escalation and signoff rules.
Do not rename the initial author to claim uninvolved reconsideration. Internal critic and actual reconsideration are distinct.
Navigation and coordination can share case obligations; external resource availability still needs evidence.
Shared transition coordination may improve continuity, but administrative readiness and clinical discharge authority differ.
Share medication/access information; technician/access activity must not acquire therapy-change authority.
Dispatcher coordination is not physical driving, pickup or attendance; only the actual environment response can establish completion.
Shared family-case context must retain separate speakers, wishes and representative facts.
A language service can offer both operations while preserving oral interaction versus written fidelity and actual qualification limits.
Interpreting a conversation is not a clinical speech/swallowing assessment; similar language-related words do not make the functions equivalent.
Common support coordination is possible, but hospice IDG/RN/attending/certification and spiritual support are distinct functions.
A policy-analysis capability can serve governance; its draft cannot approve its own controlling policy.
An internal quality critic is not the applicable physician reconsiderer or official benchmark grader.
